tools.name: run_free_scan
tools.description: Free LLM agent security review in ~35s. Two parts: (1) 8 live adversarial probes (jailbreak / prompt injection / system-prompt extraction / tool abuse) against your agent spec, and (2) a deterministic static audit of which guardrails the spec text itself is missing. Returns a 0-100 risk score, per-f

tools.name: get_scan_result
tools.description: Poll a scan by job id (returned by run_free_scan) until status=done.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: PRO pricing & payment info: 44 probes / 20 attack classes / 0-100 score / CI gate / per-class remediation, 0.15 XNO (ERC-20 or Lightning) or card.

tools.name: get_purchase_flow
tools.description: Machine-readable autonomous purchase procedure: how an agent pays (0.15 XNO, or USDC on Base via x402) and receives the PRO download with no human in the loop (callback push + poll fallback).
